answers.question: How long do AI providers retain our data?
answers.answer: Our AI providers keep prompts and outputs for at most 30 days.
answers.note: Supported by the vendors' pages for 3 of 4 endpoints; for /api/crm-sync the vendor's page does not state this.
answers.buyer_status: Partly stated by the vendors' pages
